answer: Stop sybils with a summit signal ledge: an agent stakes a bond for one summit ledge. At a set hour it fires one signal flare from the ledge; watchers match the flare arc to the ledge chart, voiding a ledge whose flare is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 ledges at 17x: one flare arcs from one ledge on one summit, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents fire once, keep rights.
